instruction: Accept the offsite invite and let Rachel know I'll be there.
final_text:
I accepted the invite to the **Q4 planning offsite** on Tuesday, Oct 6, from 9:00 to 5:00 at Presidio, Building 34. I added a note for Rachel, who organized it: "Thanks Rachel, I'll be there." She was notified along with your acceptance. I didn't send a separate email.

Nothing else is on your calendar that day.

input.comment: Thanks Rachel, I'll be there. – Sam
